**Component Name & Specs**
Name and part number of the connector, display, or switch (e.g., mini voltmeter, rocker switch model, etc.).

**Datasheet & Dimensions**
Link to the technical drawing, CAD model, or caliper measurements (panel cutout width/height, screw spacing, wall depth).

**Target Panel**
Where this cutout is typically mounted (`Front_Slope`, `Front_Lip`, `Rear`, `Right`, or `Left`).
